title: Qwen3.6-27B natural-octet-owned Q5T16 source-F16 producer full-engine qualification

change.description: For the already-qualified Qwen3.6-27B recurrent-output Q5T16 source-F16 path, assign one K256 workgroup to each natural eight-column packed group instead of one workgroup per scalar output column.
change.arithmetic: source-F16 and final BF16 bytes are byte-identical to the scalar producer
change.fallback: registered scalar column-owned Q5T16 source-F16 producer

counterbalanced_full_engine_ab.protocol: One resident session per board/shape; scalar and octet policies warmed; seven alternating pairs; each synthetic policy flip clears the dispatch cache; baseline removes only the Q5 variant policy while retaining all Q4/Q6 and consumer policies; p512/p1024/p4096 plus d128.
counterbalanced_full_engine_ab.command_template: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<1 XTX|0 W7900> HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1100 HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. /home/lhl/mambaforge/envs/therock/bin/python /tmp/qwen36_q5_octet_engine_ab.py --device <xtx|w7900> --rows <512|1024|4096> --samples 7 --decode-tokens 128 --output /tmp/qwen36-q5-octet-engine-ab-<board>-<rows>.json

decode_confirmation.scope: XTX M512, nine additional alternating pairs after a noisy first decode row

counterbalanced_full_engine_ab.decode_interpretation: Both labels execute identical exact decode owners. The focused confirmation rejects the initial noisy M512 timing dip; no decode implementation or performance claim changes.

validation.runtime_unit: Committed in 66b2293a2 after 119/119 affected kernel, registry, dispatch, and scratch-liveness tests passed.
validation.full_engine: 41/42 paired prefill wins, exact output trajectories, byte-identical tracked peaks, and strict scalar-baseline/octet-production ownership.
validation.quality: Ten prompts/four categories pass at minimum top-1 96.97% and max KL 0.009339 with 1,920 asserted octet launches.
validation.mtp: Full ten-prompt/four-category B1-B3 serial-exact safeguard passes all greedy and GPU/CPU acceptance checks and closes tracked allocations to zero.

decision: Retain the exact natural-octet-owned Q5 source-F16 producer as the Qwen3.6-27B K6144/N5120 M512-M4096 default. It improves every binding full-engine cell with no arithmetic, memory, decode, or MTP ownership change; keep scalar and pair leaves as registered fallbacks/diagnostics. Publish the fresh selector-unset matrix and re-profile M512 before selecting another lane.
